name: phd-summer-maximum-seminar-and-warning
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#69, #70): an early-start summer over Academic Code §3.8’s ten — a research seminar refused by the maximum read “not counted” on its line and “done” on the seminar card; and the warning said “so 2 credits are not counted” though the maximum’s own cut was different. The seminar counts toward its requirement only when its credit counts, and the warning names the credits the maximum itself refused.
expectWarnings: Summer 2026: 13 credits of courses are entered — the Graduate School allows at most 10 in the summer session (Academic Code §3.8; DGS Handbook §3.9), so 3 credits are not counted.
